name: Dataset Preprocessing (DeepLesion)
definition: Preprocessing steps for the DeepLesion dataset to prepare tomographic images for training, involving Hounsfield Unit conversion, thresholding, and cropping.
summary: DeepLesion preprocessing converts CT scans to Hounsfield Units, segments the body from air using a fixed -9050 HU threshold, and crops to a 256x256 square, differing from general methods by using fixed thresholding rather than statistical normalization.
